Earlier reports revealed that WhatsApp was developing a new chat theme feature, and this functionality has now been officially rolled out to iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp's new chat themes add dynamic wallpapers

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now introducing five new chat theme categories: Featured, Nature, Dynamic, Minimal, and Doodle. Two weeks ago, the website discovered clues about the new theme series in the app's code.

The website noted that the Featured category includes the "best theme combinations" carefully curated by WhatsApp's design team; the Nature category "brings the outdoors into the chat screen." The Dynamic category "adds a slowly moving wallpaper to the background," while the Minimal theme "sets the chat screen to a solid colour background: white in light mode and black in dark mode." As for the Doodle category, it features WhatsApp's classic wallpapers with doodle patterns.

Below is WABetaInfo's introduction to dynamic wallpapers, arguably the most noteworthy new feature:

WABetaInfo stated that WhatsApp will automatically adjust the colour of chat bubbles based on the selected theme, and pointed out that, as with other WhatsApp feature rollouts, the new functionality may not be immediately available to all users.
